verdict.rationale: Skyvern clearly supports repeatable multi-step workflows rather than one-shot prompts. The docs describe a drag-and-drop visual workflow builder with shareable templates, a code-first SDK for multi-step automations, a recorder that turns manual actions into reusable automations, and SOP-to-workflow generation. However, the evidence never mentions loops, conditionals, or parameterized inputs, which are the core composition primitives the story asks for. missing for 10: documented loop blocks, conditional/branching logic, workflow parameters/inputs, independent hands-on corroboration of workflow composition.
